Meet Bask Balm™ — the feel-good lip SPF. Part balm, part gloss, all protection, our first-ever SPF 30 lip balm glides on with a cushiony, butter-balm texture that feels rich but never sticky or waxy. It leaves a soft, glossy sheen that enhances your natural lip look, with a subtle, sweet hint of vanilla in every swipe.

Enriched with Vitamin E, safflower seed oil, and Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Bask Balm locks in moisture and helps prevent water loss for soft, comfortable lips all day — while broad spectrum SPF 30 keeps them protected. Wear it solo or layer it over or under color without pilling.

Water resistant (80 minutes). Hawaii reef friendly, oxybenzone & octinoxate free, paraben & sulfate free, cruelty-free & Leaping Bunny Certified, and dermatologist recommended.
